candidates.title: AI Video Creator & Editor at Creativefabrica
candidates.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Creative Fabrica</strong></p> <p>Creative Fabrica is a fast-growing AI platform that makes it easy for everyday consumers to create whatever they imagine, from images and videos to audio and 3D creations, using the latest generative AI models.</p></div><p>You know that feeling when a new AI model drops and you can’t wait to create something with it? We want to make that excitement contagious. Every new model, tool and feature we launch is a chance to show people something they hadn’t imagined creating themselves. We want videos they immediately send to friends, ideas they can’t wait to try and people opening our tools because they HAVE to make something. That’s where you come in!</p> <h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p><strong>This is a full-time, in-office role at our Amsterdam HQ, with 30 work-from-anywhere days per year.</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for someone who LOVES generating videos with AI and knows how to turn a great idea into a video people can’t ignore. You’re already making AI movies, creating unexpected visual effects and refining your prompts until the result matches the idea in your head. candidates.description: About The RoleWe're looking for a Senior Product Manager with real technical depth and an AI-first way of working. You'll own a product area end to end: finding problems worth solving, shaping the solution, taking it from 0 to 1 and growing it from there.You understand architecture, you've written code, you know how databases work, and you speak engineering fluently. Your main job is product. The technical depth is what lets you move faster and make better calls.AI isn't a feature we're adding. It's how we work and how we build. Expect roughly 70% product and 30% engineering, with full accountability for results.Your MissionProduct direction: set the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area. Run interviews, usability tests and experiments before committing to build.Metrics and outcomes: define, instrument and track the KPIs for your area. Use product analytics to find friction, prioritise the highest-impact work, and shut down what doesn't work.Engineering partnership: understand architectural trade-offs, review technical approaches and unblock decisions. candidates.description: About The RoleWe’re looking for a Security Engineer to own and improve the security of our internal environment — the identities, SaaS apps, endpoints, AI tooling, and networks our employees use every day. This is a hands-on senior role: we expect you to design controls, find the gaps, and drive the changes that close them — and to build the automation that makes it scale.We’re an EMI-licensed fintech in a fully cloud-native AWS environment, we use AI heavily, and we’re growing fast. candidates.description: About The RoleVivid Money is redefining how modern corporates, holding structures, and financial institutions manage and optimize their capital. From institutional-grade Treasury products (high-yield Interest Accounts, Money Market Funds, and ETFs) to multi-currency infrastructure and FX solutions, we provide the financial architecture that traditional banks make too slow and expensive.We are expanding our institutional footprint in the Netherlands.We aren’t looking for a standard software sales rep; we are looking for a New Business Account Executive who understands the fabric of the Dutch financial ecosystem.
